title: C# library roadmap
description: Milestones M2–M10 of the C# engine-interface plan, with the questions of docs/operations.md each answers and what library 0.3 already has.

entities.title: M2 typed model
entities.summary: One typed record per kind, parsing, canonical JSON and representation equality.
answers: A1 Is this well-formed UTV?
I4 Canonical bytes / hash / signature for storage and dedup

origin.description: The C# engine-interface design plan, written after library 0.1.0, with a note added in 0.3.0 on what 0.3 realizes. Its prose sections (design decisions, evolution table, milestones, 0.3 note) moved into these .dev files; the file keeps the interface sketch, and git history keeps the original text.

entities.progress: Library 0.3 did part of M2 (the plan's note): immutable sealed records with representation equality for the everyday kinds only (CivilDate, CivilYearMonth, CivilTime, CivilDateTime, FixedOffsetDateTime, ZonedIntent, Instant, Period, PosixSeconds, ElapsedSeconds, Interval<T>), with Parse, FromJson and ToJson. Not the 26 kinds, and no RFC 8785 canonical JSON.
entities.details: Each milestone adds a conformance profile (spec §2); anything outside the profiles a milestone claims keeps returning Unsupported. Targets are the plan's order: it gives no dates.

entities.title: M3 core-civil
entities.summary: The core-civil profile: Gregorian and ISO week rules, validation, fields, civil comparison and calendar arithmetic.
goals: Add and Difference on calendar amounts
answers: A2 Does it make sense (Feb 30? 25:00?)
B4 What day of the week / ISO week / quarter is it?
C1 Did A happen before B? (civil)
D2 How many months/days between two dates?
E1 What is A plus one month / minus a day?

entities.progress: Parts exist in the 0.2 JSON layer and the 0.3 typed layer: GregorianCivil.Validate, Calendar.Fields (ISO week, day of week), Calendar.Compare for civil values, Calendar.Add for calendar amounts and Calendar.DaysBetween. There is no Difference on calendar amounts (only days between dates), and the profile is not claimed.

entities.title: M4 global-instant

goals: Timescale registry (POSIX, UTC with leap table, TAI)
answers: C1 Did A happen before B?
D1 How much time elapsed between A and B?

entities.title: M5 zoned
entities.summary: The zoned profile: TZif rules, resolution, conversion between instants and civil values, day bounds, truncation and BCL adapters.
answers: B1 Which instant(s) does this local date-time denote?
B2 What does the wall clock read at instant t in zone/place Z?
B5 When does this day start and end here?
E3 Round/truncate to the hour, day or week?
I5 Convert from/to a platform type

entities.progress: Resolve and instant-to-civil conversion exist with caller-supplied rules in the demo-zones.json format, not TZif (Zones.Resolve, Zones.ToZone, Zones.ToOffset, ZonedIntent.Resolve, Instant.InZone), and .NET interop exists (Interop and the typed From…/To… methods). There is no TZif loader, DayBounds or Truncate.

C5 Are these the same?
F5 Union/intersection/difference of availability windows

entities.title: M7 recurrence
entities.summary: The recurrence profile: RFC 5545 expansion, occurrence IDs, selection and an iCalendar adapter.
answers: F1 When are the next N occurrences / those within a window?
F2 Is date X an occurrence of this schedule?
F3 Which original occurrence is this (after it was moved)?
F4 Third Wednesday, last business day, first match in a window?
I1 Parse this ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 / RFC 9557 / iCalendar text
I2 Export to those formats
